For 8,000Hz polling + Hall Effect switches under $100, I'd prioritize rapid-trigger performance, software quality, and build quality over advertised latency alone.

My top picks for November 2026 are the MCHOSE Ace 60 Pro, MonsGeek FUN60 Ultra, and EPOMAKER HE68 Lite.

Best 8K Hall Effect keyboards under $100

1. MCHOSE Ace 60 Pro

Best for competitive FPS
$41.65

60% · 8K polling · Rapid Trigger · Wired

Excellent value for Valorant and CS2, with adjustable magnetic switches and a compact layout. My first choice for pure gaming at this price.

View at B&H

2. MonsGeek FUN60 Ultra

Best alternative
$59.99

60% · 8K polling · Magnetic switches · Wired

Strong choice for switch customization and gaming performance. Check the exact FUN60 version, since the HE and TMR variants differ.

View at Micro Center

3. EPOMAKER HE68 Lite

Best budget 65%
$42.49

65% · 8K polling · 128K scan rate · Wired

Dedicated arrow keys, rapid trigger, and SOCD features. A particularly good value if you don't want a 60% layout.

View at Newegg

4. Redragon K673 HE

$59.99

75% · 8K polling · Hall Effect · Wired

Better for everyday typing with a function row, arrow keys, and volume knob. Less compact but more practical.

View at Newegg
